name: officehub-skills
description: OfficeHub team skills: furniture product angle prompts and an SEO toolkit

plugins.name: officehub-product-angles
plugins.description: Turn one photo of an office-furniture item plus its dimensions into ready-to-paste prompts for every other angle (front, 3/4, sides, back, top, detail), check the results, and prepare file names, Arabic/English alt text and the AI label for upload. Works in Claude chat with no API key.

plugins.name: officehub-seo
plugins.description: SEO toolkit for officehub.sa and any website: site and page audits, technical SEO, schema, product and category pages, Arabic and English keywords and content, AI search (GEO), local SEO, hreflang, content briefs and SEO plans. Knows the Saudi market and Shopify/WooCommerce. No API key needed.
